identification.summary: Malpedia maintains an actor entry named "Mana Team" with no associated malware families; its only listed reference is a HackDig article dated 2016-02-17 titled "Russian Police Prevented Massive Banking Sector Cyber Attack" [S1].
identification.notes: The 2016-02 date is the date of the only reference Malpedia lists, not a verified first-activity date [S1]. No searched source describing the group's activity was retrievable, so the link between the name and the banking-sector case rests solely on that Malpedia reference listing [S1].

gaps: The HackDig article (2016-02-17) and its original upstream report could not be opened; only its title is known via Malpedia.
The encyclopedia record lists country CN; no source retrieved supports a China origin or any state sponsorship.
The case described in the article title appears to concern Russian police and the Russian banking sector, which conflicts with the CN origin tag; unresolved.
Whether the related 2016 Russian Interior Ministry banking-crime reporting (about 50 arrests) concerns this group is unverified; no retrieved source names Mana Team in it.
No malware, TTPs, infrastructure, victims, vendor aliases, or MITRE group ID could be identified.
Malpedia page itself could not be fetched (host unreachable); content is from search-result snippets only.
Possible name confusion with other groups is unresolved; no vendor cluster mapping was found.

sources.title: Mana Team (Malpedia actor entry; lists HackDig 'Russian Police Prevented Massive Banking Sector Cyber Attack')
